reference: PROSPECT site (operator-built on spec, docs/LIASSE_DANCE.md Part 13)

languages.selection: ?lang= wins, then /en/ path prefix, then the scoped pwa_lang cookie.
languages.content: Bilingual editorial settings are JSON {fr,en} rows in admin_settings; services carry _en columns; text_<key>_<lang> rows override dictionary keys.

features.booking: 4-step wizard (work → vehicle with VIN decode via NHTSA vPIC → day/time from real availability → sign-in + details) → appointment. Availability = hours − closures − lead time, on a bay grid (setting bays × slot_minutes). bay_slots PRIMARY KEY (bay, slot_at) is the concurrency guard; idempotent on (user_id, request_key).
features.accounts: Platform visitor auth (services.auth; email/SMS code, biometrics). customer_profiles + vehicles are keyed by the platform users.id as TEXT. Customers view, reschedule and cancel (until cancel_cutoff_hours) and download .ics.
features.admin: /admin dashboard (launch checklist, requests to confirm), /admin/rendez-vous board (days × bays, status drawer with customer message + internal note), generic modules: services, customer_profiles, vehicles, hours, closures, messages; /admin/settings (gates, booking rules, texts, privacy).
features.planner: Client-side maintenance planner (typical intervals) + Québec winter-tire countdown.
features.notifications: lib/notify.js — sends ONLY when live_actions_enabled=1 AND appointment.preview=0. crons.js sends 24 h reminders under the same rule.

gates.notes: Phone/address/hours are shown from the public listing; the checklist asks the owner to confirm them. bookings_live requires privacy_approved; while off, appointments are stored with preview=1 and the UI says so.

rules: Brand moments = charcoal emblem plates; flows = cream shop ticket in orange-brown

assets: lib/assets.js — logo remake (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst edit of their 411 logo), app mark, hero + 11 service illustrations (gpt-image-2.5-flare), Cloudinary folder tapavis_tenant_garage_el_mirabel. All illustrations, never photographs of the shop.
gaps: No email address known for the garage — notification_email is empty; notifications go to the Liasse account email once claimed.
No prices published anywhere — every service shows « Sur estimation » until the owner fills price_from_cents and ticks price_verified.
Service durations are planning estimates (edit in admin/services).
Number of service bays unknown — default 2 (setting bays).
Courtesy car count unknown — default 1 because the listing offers « Voiture de courtoisie».
No statutory holidays seeded as closures — the owner adds them.
Privacy notice is a Law 25 DRAFT with the responsible person's name to complete.
No photographs of the shop or team were available; none are shown.
